tweet_summary: Nostalgia post: 'In 2006 Will Ferrell joined SNL musical guests Queens of the Stone Age as his BÖC "Cowbell" character from 6 years earlier' with the actual performance video and a story about Josh Homme.
why_note_decision: The original cowbell sketch did air April 8, 2000 and Ferrell's QOTSA appearance was May 14, 2005 (not 2006). So technically the tweet has a small date error AND a counting error (5 years from 2000 to 2005, not 6). But this is exactly the trivial pedantry the community flagged — the substance of the post (Ferrell reprised cowbell on SNL with QOTSA, ~5+ years after the sketch, Homme broke character laughing) is correct and is not what readers care about. notHelpfulNoteNotNeeded was the dominant tag.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. A pedantic year correction on a nostalgic showbiz post is a clear notHelpfulNoteNotNeeded false positive — readers gain no value from learning the appearance was 2005 not 2006, and the substantive story is accurate.

original_unhelpful_note.text: This SNL performance occurred on May 14, 2005, not 2006. The original "More Cowbell" sketch aired on April 8, 2000, five years earlier.
